name: IT Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least 2 years of professional experience in the information technology sector.
Requires annual income of at least USD 25,000 from IT-sector work.

evidence_required.document: Proof of annual income at or above USD 25,000

outcome.duration_length: 3 years initially, extendable up to a cumulative 12 years

sources.title: Legislative Herald of Georgia (matsne.gov.ge) -- Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15(l)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. category set to 'work_independent' since this route's income basis (USD 25,000/year in IT-sector work) does not require Georgian employer sponsorship in the way ge_work_residence_permit does -- it is the closest thing Georgia has to a remote-tech/nomad-style route today, distinct from the lapsed 'Remotely from Georgia' pandemic-era program mentioned in ge_visa_free_entry's notes. work_rights 'restricted' as a conservative default: the specific scope (remote-only vs. any IT work) was not detailed in the sources fetched in this pass.
